common.logoutConfirm: Lock your space? You'll need your PIN to come back in.
common.startOverConfirm: Leave setup and start over? What you've entered so far won't be saved.

s01.listen: I'm here to listen, support, and help you feel better.
s01.brave: You've just taken a brave step by being here. Whether you're feeling stressed, worried, sad, or just need someone to talk to — I'm here for you.
s01.ctaSub: It only takes a few minutes to start feeling supported
s01.learnSub: Quick tour of what to expect
s01.needHelpSub: If you're in crisis or having thoughts of hurting yourself, please get help immediately.
s01.rememberSub: Thousands of students just like you use ARAM to feel better. You've got this!

s02.intro1: This space is just for you.
s02.emisNote: Your school code only helps me set your school space. I do not ask for your full name.

s02b.title: Is your school a Tamil Nadu Government school?
s02b.subtitle: This helps me find your school details automatically.
s02b.yesSub: I'll look up your school using its EMIS code
s02b.noSub: Skip ahead — I'll set up your space another way

s02c.notFound: I couldn't find that school code. Please check it and try again.

s03.title: What shall I call you?
s03.subtitle: You can use a nickname or any name you like.
s03.fieldsSpoken: Please enter your nickname, your date of birth, and create a four-digit PIN.
s03.dobNote: I convert your date of birth to an age group and do not store your full birthday
s03.pinNote: This PIN is only to keep your space private
s03.errPinMismatch: The two PINs don't match. Please try again.
s03.errNickname: Please tell me what to call you.
s03.errDob: Please enter a valid date of birth.

s04.title: A note for your parent or guardian
s04.subtitle: Please hand the phone to a trusted adult
s04.does1: Helps your child talk about how they feel
s04.does3: Connects to helplines if there is a safety concern
s04.privacy1: We do not share your child's responses with teachers
s04.privacy2: Only minimal data shared with helplines in emergencies
s04.consentNote: By tapping 'I give my consent' you confirm you are a parent or guardian and agree to ARAM supporting this child.

s05.title: Can I support you from here, {{name}}?
s05.titleSpoken: Can I support you from here?
s05.can1: Help you notice and calm difficult feelings
s05.can2: Suggest small steps that may make things lighter
s05.can3: Help you reach a real helper if I'm very worried about your safety
s05.cannot1: Replace a doctor, teacher, or counsellor
s05.cannot3: Share your details without your permission, except for your safety
s05.warm: I'm here to help you feel a little calmer, a little clearer, and not alone with what you're feeling.
s05.question: Is it okay if I stay with you and support you in the ways I can?
s05.privacyNote: Your privacy matters. You can stop anytime.
s05.notNowMessage: Thank you for considering ARAM. You can return anytime.

s05b.title: Let's register your face
s05b.subtitle: So you can log back in with a PIN or your face
s05b.why1: A quick way back into your space, alongside your PIN
s05b.why2: We never share your face data outside your account
s05b.why3: You can always use your PIN instead
s05b.captureCtaSub: Tap to turn on your camera
s05b.cameraError: We couldn't access your camera. That's okay — you can register your face later, and your PIN will always work to log in.
s05b.registered: Face registered! You can use it to log in next time.
s05b.note: This step is part of setting up your space. If it doesn't work on this device, your PIN always works.

s06.title: Can we use your camera?
s06.subtitle: This is completely optional
s06.why1: Sometimes your face shows how you feel — even when it's hard to say in words
s06.why2: We never save photos or videos
s06.why3: We only look at your expressions for a moment
s06.allowSub: Helps understand your emotions · optional · change anytime
s06.note: If you say no, ARAM still works fully. Camera is never used without your permission.

s07.title: Can we listen to your voice?
s07.subtitle: Also completely optional
s07.why1: The tone of your voice can tell us how you're really feeling
s07.why2: We never record or store your voice
s07.why3: We only listen to the rhythm and tone for a moment
s07.allowSub: Helps understand your mood · optional · change anytime
s07.note: Voice is separate from camera. You can allow one without the other.

s08.title: You're all set, {{name}}!
s08.settingsNote: You can change camera and voice settings anytime from the menu.
s08.readyNote: ARAM is ready. Let's start by picking what you'd like to talk about today.

s09.note: Your PIN keeps your space private. Forgot your PIN? Contact your school coordinator.
s09.errWrong: That PIN wasn't right. {{remaining}} tries left.
s09.lockedSub: For your safety this space is locked. Please contact your school coordinator to unlock it.

s10.welcomeBack: Welcome back! It's been {{days}} days since your last visit.
s10.todayLabel: What would you like to do today?
s10.journey1Sub: You started your journey to wellness
s10.urgentSub: If you're in crisis or having thoughts of hurting yourself, we're here.
s10.progressSub: Every time you show up here, you're taking care of yourself. That's something to be proud of.

s11.title: Just checking in on something
s11.warm: Last time we spoke, things felt a bit heavy. I wanted to ask — would you like to talk to a real person about what you've been going through?
s11.yesTitle: Yes, I'd like to talk to someone
s11.yesSub: I'm ready for that support now
s11.laterSub: I'm okay for now, let's continue
s11.note: Whatever you choose is completely okay. This is your space.

emergency.title: You're not alone right now
emergency.subtitle: If you're in danger or thinking of hurting yourself, please reach out. Talking to someone helps.
emergency.reassure: Reaching out is a brave and strong thing to do. These services are free and confidential.

voice.unsupported: Voice input isn't available on this device.
voice.headphonesHint: Tip: use headphones if you'd like to keep this private.
